tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch one user row (public neighbourhood profile) by id
tools.sql: SELECT u.id, NULL AS public_contact_email, u.name, u.photo_url, u.role, u.suburb, u.postcode, u.state, u.country, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.email END AS email, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.lat END AS lat, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.lng END AS lng, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.client_profile WHEN json_valid(u.client_profile) THEN json_remove(u.client_profile, '$.addressNumber', '$.natureStripPhotos') END AS client_profile, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.mower_profile WHEN json_valid(u.mower_profile) THEN json_remove(u.mower_profile, '$.addressNumber', '$.homeStreetName') END AS mower_profile, u.street_group_id, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u WHERE u.id = :id AND (u.id = :__user_id OR u.role = 'mower' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) mm WHERE mm.value = u.id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id))))

caller_unscoped.reason: mower profiles are a public hire directory (name, photo, suburb, rate, radius, bio); client rows only to self, fellow street-group members and platform admins; email, lat/lng, house number, home street and verge photos masked to self/admin

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users filtered by role/suburb/postcode (neighbourhood directory)
tools.sql: SELECT u.id, NULL AS public_contact_email, u.name, u.photo_url, u.role, u.suburb, u.postcode, u.state, u.country, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.email END AS email, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.lat END AS lat, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.lng END AS lng, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.client_profile WHEN json_valid(u.client_profile) THEN json_remove(u.client_profile, '$.addressNumber', '$.natureStripPhotos') END AS client_profile, CASE WHEN (u.id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) THEN u.mower_profile WHEN json_valid(u.mower_profile) THEN json_remove(u.mower_profile, '$.addressNumber', '$.homeStreetName') END AS mower_profile, u.street_group_id, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u WHERE (:role IS NULL OR u.role = :role) AND (:suburb IS NULL OR u.suburb = :suburb) AND (:postcode IS NULL OR u.postcode = :postcode) AND (u.id = :__user_id OR u.role = 'mower' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY u.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

caller_unscoped.reason: public mower hire directory (Share/hire page); non-admins see only mower rows plus themself; email, lat/lng, house number and home street masked to self/admin

tools.name: get_public_mower_contact
tools.description: Resolve a mower's explicitly published hire-enquiry email address
tools.sql: SELECT public_contact_email FROM users WHERE id = :mower_id AND role = 'mower' AND public_contact_email IS NOT NULL AND trim(public_contact_email) <> ''

tools.name: create_me
tools.description: Create the caller's own client or mower row (first-time onboarding; the verified caller cannot self-assign admin)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, photo_url, role, suburb, postcode, state, country, lat, lng, client_profile, mower_profile, street_group_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :email, :name, :photo_url, :role, :suburb, :postcode, :state, :country, :lat, :lng, :client_profile, :mower_profile, NULL, :__now, :__now WHERE :role IN ('client', 'mower')

tools.name: update_me
tools.description: Update the caller's own profile fields; role changes are restricted to admin_set_role and a group pointer must match verified membership
tools.sql: UPDATE users SET email = CASE WHEN :set_email = 1 THEN :email ELSE email END, public_contact_email = CASE WHEN :set_public_contact_email = 1 THEN NULLIF(trim(:public_contact_email), '') ELSE public_contact_email END, name = CASE WHEN :set_name = 1 THEN :name ELSE name END, photo_url = CASE WHEN :set_photo_url = 1 THEN :photo_url ELSE photo_url END, suburb = CASE WHEN :set_suburb = 1 THEN :suburb ELSE suburb END, postcode = CASE WHEN :set_postcode = 1 THEN :postcode ELSE postcode END, state = CASE WHEN :set_state = 1 THEN :state ELSE state END, country = CASE WHEN :set_country = 1 THEN :country ELSE country END, lat = CASE WHEN :set_lat = 1 THEN :lat ELSE lat END, lng = CASE WHEN :set_lng = 1 THEN :lng ELSE lng END, client_profile = CASE WHEN :set_client_profile = 1 THEN :client_profile ELSE client_profile END, mower_profile = CASE WHEN :set_mower_profile = 1 THEN :mower_profile ELSE mower_profile END, street_group_id = CASE WHEN :set_street_group_id = 1 THEN :street_group_id ELSE street_group_id END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :__user_id AND (:set_public_contact_email = 0 OR role = 'mower') AND (:set_street_group_id = 0 OR :street_group_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :street_group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id)))

tools.name: admin_set_role
tools.description: Set any user's role (platform admins only — caller must be a user with role='admin')
tools.sql: UPDATE users SET role = :role, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')

tools.name: admin_delete_user
tools.description: Atomically delete an account and clean its group memberships, delegated group-admin role (promoting a remaining member where possible), mower assignments/interests, votes, reviews, and job history. Callers may delete only themselves; platform admins may delete any user.
statements: UPDATE street_groups SET admin_ids = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id) THEN (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT json_array(member.value) FROM json_each(member_ids) member JOIN users successor ON successor.id = member.value WHERE member.value != :user_id AND successor.role IN ('client', 'admin') ORDER BY member.key LIMIT 1), json_array()) END, member_ids = (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value != :user_id), assigned_mower_id = CASE WHEN assigned_mower_id = :user_id THEN NULL ELSE assigned_mower_id END, status = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) member JOIN users successor ON successor.id = member.value WHERE member.value != :user_id AND successor.role IN ('client', 'admin')) THEN 'archived' ELSE status END, updated_at = :__now WHERE (assigned_mower_id = :user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id)) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE voter_id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id IN (SELECT id FROM mower_interests WHERE mower_id = :user_id) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM mower_interests WHERE mower_id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE user_id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
UPDATE schedules SET mower_id = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE mower_id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM mower_reviews WHERE (mower_id = :user_id OR reviewer_id = :user_id) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM history_records WHERE mower_id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
DELETE FROM users WHERE id = :user_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List street groups filtered by status/suburb/postcode/assigned mower
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM street_groups WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (:suburb IS NULL OR suburb = :suburb) AND (:postcode IS NULL OR postcode = :postcode) AND (:mower_id IS NULL OR assigned_mower_id = :mower_id) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

caller_unscoped.reason: public street-group directory used to find/join a street and for mowers to find forming streets: street name, suburb, postcode, status, street-centre coords and opaque member ids; no contact or house-level address data

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Fetch one street group by id
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id)) OR g.assigned_mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Atomically create a street group with the caller as its sole admin and member, and set the caller's group pointer. The normalized (trimmed, case-insensitive) suburb + postcode + street tuple is unique; an existing tuple is safely ignored for the caller to resolve as a conflict.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO street_groups (id, name, street_name, suburb, postcode, state, country, center_lat, center_lng, admin_ids, member_ids, assigned_mower_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :name, trim(:street_name), trim(:suburb), trim(:postcode), :state, :country, :center_lat, :center_lng, json_array(:__user_id), json_array(:__user_id), NULL, 'forming', :__now, :__now FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'client' AND u.street_group_id IS NULL AND length(trim(:street_name)) > 0 AND length(trim(:suburb)) > 0 AND trim(:postcode) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'

UPDATE users SET street_group_id = :id, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :__user_id AND role = 'client' AND street_group_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id))

tools.name: find_group_by_location
tools.description: Find a street group by its normalized (trimmed, case-insensitive) suburb + postcode + street tuple, used to present duplicate-create conflicts safely.
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM street_groups WHERE lower(trim(COALESCE(suburb, ''))) = lower(trim(:suburb)) AND lower(trim(COALESCE(postcode, ''))) = lower(trim(:postcode)) AND lower(trim(COALESCE(street_name, ''))) = lower(trim(:street_name)) LIMIT 1

caller_unscoped.reason: Street group locations are already visible in the authenticated street-group directory; this exact lookup prevents duplicate creation and lets a caller request to join the existing group.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Update a street group's profile/status/assigned mower (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET name = CASE WHEN :set_name = 1 THEN :name ELSE name END, street_name = CASE WHEN :set_street_name = 1 THEN :street_name ELSE street_name END, suburb = CASE WHEN :set_suburb = 1 THEN :suburb ELSE suburb END, postcode = CASE WHEN :set_postcode = 1 THEN :postcode ELSE postcode END, state = CASE WHEN :set_state = 1 THEN :state ELSE state END, country = CASE WHEN :set_country = 1 THEN :country ELSE country END, center_lat = CASE WHEN :set_center_lat = 1 THEN :center_lat ELSE center_lat END, center_lng = CASE WHEN :set_center_lng = 1 THEN :center_lng ELSE center_lng END, status = CASE WHEN :set_status = 1 THEN :status ELSE status END, assigned_mower_id = CASE WHEN :set_assigned_mower_id = 1 THEN :assigned_mower_id ELSE assigned_mower_id END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(street_groups.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) AND (:set_assigned_mower_id = 0 OR :assigned_mower_id IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users m WHERE m.id = :assigned_mower_id AND m.role = 'mower') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mower_interests mi WHERE mi.group_id = street_groups.id AND mi.mower_id = :assigned_mower_id)))

tools.name: add_group_member
tools.description: Atomically add a client to a group and set their group pointer (group/platform admins, or a caller accepting their own join request).
statements: UPDATE street_groups SET member_ids = json_insert(member_ids, '$[#]', :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = :user_id AND u.role = 'client' AND (u.street_group_id IS NULL OR u.street_group_id = :group_id)) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) OR (:user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_group_interests i WHERE i.group_id = :group_id AND i.user_id = :__user_id)))

UPDATE users SET street_group_id = :group_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :user_id AND role = 'client' AND (street_group_id IS NULL OR street_group_id = :group_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) OR (:user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_group_interests i WHERE i.group_id = :group_id AND i.user_id = :__user_id))))

tools.name: remove_group_member
tools.description: Atomically remove a non-admin user from a group and clear their group pointer (self-leave, or a group/platform admin); remove_group_admin must run first for admins.
statements: UPDATE street_groups SET member_ids = (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value != :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

UPDATE users SET street_group_id = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :user_id AND street_group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

tools.name: add_group_admin
tools.description: Add a user to a group's admin list (existing group admins or platform admins only). No-op if already an admin.
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET admin_ids = json_insert(admin_ids, '$[#]', :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: remove_group_admin
tools.description: Remove a user from a group's admin list (existing group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET admin_ids = (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id)

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group, clear every member pointer, and remove its schedules, interests, mower-interests and votes atomically (group/platform admins only)
statements: UPDATE users SET street_group_id = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE street_group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM schedules WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id IN (SELECT id FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM street_groups WHERE id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(street_groups.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: create_group_interest
tools.description: Express the caller's interest in joining a street group (upsert on group+user; the caller is the applicant)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO street_group_interests (id, group_id, user_id, message, created_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :__user_id, :message, :__now FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'client' AND u.street_group_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND g.status IN ('forming', 'active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id)) ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, created_at = excluded.created_at

tools.name: list_group_interests
tools.description: List join-interest requests for a group, newest first (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: SELECT i.* FROM street_group_interests i JOIN street_groups g ON g.id = i.group_id WHERE i.group_id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

tools.name: delete_group_interest
tools.description: Delete a group join-interest — either the applicant themselves, or a group admin / platform admin of the target group
tools.sql: DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE id = :id AND (user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = street_group_interests.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))))

tools.name: approve_group_interest
tools.description: Atomically approve a pending join request, add the applicant to the group, and clear the request (group admins or platform admins only)
statements: UPDATE street_groups SET member_ids = json_insert(member_ids, '$[#]', :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_group_interests i WHERE i.id = :interest_id AND i.group_id = :group_id AND i.user_id = :user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = :user_id AND u.role = 'client' AND u.street_group_id IS NULL) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

UPDATE users SET street_group_id = :group_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :user_id AND role = 'client' AND street_group_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_group_interests i WHERE i.id = :interest_id AND i.group_id = :group_id AND i.user_id = :user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE id = :interest_id AND group_id = :group_id AND user_id = :user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = :user_id AND u.street_group_id = :group_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List a group's schedules ordered by due date then day of week
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE group_id = :group_id AND (schedules.mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = schedules.group_id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id)) OR g.assigned_mower_id = :__user_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, day_of_week ASC NULLS LAST

tools.name: list_schedules_for_mower
tools.description: List the calling mower's own schedules
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE mower_id = :__user_id ORDER BY due_date DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule for a group (group admins or platform admins only). day_of_week is 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday); start_time is 24-hour HH:MM.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO schedules (id, group_id, day_of_week, start_time, mower_id, status, due_date, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :day_of_week, :start_time, :mower_id, 'planned', :due_date, NULL, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))) AND (:mower_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users m WHERE m.id = :mower_id AND m.role = 'mower'))

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: Update a schedule (group admins/platform admins, or the assigned mower updating status/completion). day_of_week is 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday); start_time is 24-hour HH:MM.
tools.sql: UPDATE schedules SET day_of_week = CASE WHEN :set_day_of_week = 1 THEN :day_of_week ELSE day_of_week END, start_time = CASE WHEN :set_start_time = 1 THEN :start_time ELSE start_time END, mower_id = CASE WHEN :set_mower_id = 1 THEN :mower_id ELSE mower_id END, status = CASE WHEN :set_status = 1 THEN :status ELSE status END, due_date = CASE WHEN :set_due_date = 1 THEN :due_date ELSE due_date END, completed_at = CASE WHEN :set_completed_at = 1 THEN :completed_at ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (:set_mower_id = 0 OR :mower_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users m WHERE m.id = :mower_id AND m.role = 'mower')) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = schedules.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))) OR (schedules.mower_id = :__user_id AND :set_day_of_week = 0 AND :set_start_time = 0 AND :set_mower_id = 0 AND :set_due_date = 0 AND :set_status = 1 AND :status = 'done' AND :set_completed_at = 1))

tools.name: complete_schedule
tools.description: Atomically mark the calling mower's assigned schedule complete and create its history record
statements: UPDATE schedules SET status = 'done', completed_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :schedule_id AND group_id = :group_id AND mower_id = :__user_id AND status = 'planned' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'mower')

INSERT INTO history_records (id, mower_id, group_id, schedule_id, street_name, area_sqm, duration_min, income, date) SELECT :history_id, :__user_id, s.group_id, s.id, :street_name, :area_sqm, :duration_min, :income, :date FROM schedules s WHERE s.id = :schedule_id AND s.group_id = :group_id AND s.mower_id = :__user_id AND s.status = 'done' AND s.completed_at = :__now

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a schedule (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM schedules WHERE id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = schedules.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Create a mower review authored by the caller (reviewer is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_reviews (id, mower_id, reviewer_id, group_id, schedule_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :mower_id, :__user_id, :group_id, :schedule_id, :rating, :comment, :__now, :__now FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users m WHERE m.id = :mower_id AND m.role = 'mower') AND (:group_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id))) AND (:schedule_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedules s WHERE s.id = :schedule_id AND s.group_id = :group_id AND s.mower_id = :mower_id AND s.status = 'done'))

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews for a mower, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, mower_id, CASE WHEN reviewer_id = :__user_id THEN reviewer_id END AS reviewer_id, CASE WHEN reviewer_id = :__user_id THEN group_id END AS group_id, CASE WHEN reviewer_id = :__user_id THEN schedule_id END AS schedule_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at FROM mower_reviews WHERE mower_id = :mower_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

caller_unscoped.reason: public reviews on a mower's profile: rating, comment and date; reviewer, group and schedule ids masked unless the caller wrote the review

tools.name: update_review
tools.description: Update the caller's own review (only the review's author may edit)
tools.sql: UPDATE mower_reviews SET rating = CASE WHEN :set_rating = 1 THEN :rating ELSE rating END, comment = CASE WHEN :set_comment = 1 THEN :comment ELSE comment END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND reviewer_id = :__user_id

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Delete a review — either its author, or a platform admin
tools.sql: DELETE FROM mower_reviews WHERE id = :id AND (reviewer_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: average_rating
tools.description: Average rating and review count for a mower
tools.sql: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM mower_reviews WHERE mower_id = :mower_id

caller_unscoped.reason: public aggregate rating (AVG + COUNT only) shown on a mower's profile

tools.name: record_history
tools.description: Record a completed-job history entry for the caller as the mower (mower_id is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO history_records (id, mower_id, group_id, schedule_id, street_name, area_sqm, duration_min, income, date) SELECT :id, :__user_id, :group_id, :schedule_id, :street_name, :area_sqm, :duration_min, :income, :date FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'mower' AND (:schedule_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedules s WHERE s.id = :schedule_id AND s.mower_id = :__user_id AND (:group_id IS NULL OR s.group_id = :group_id)))

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: List a mower's job history, most recent first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM history_records WHERE mower_id = :mower_id AND (mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: list_interests_for_group
tools.description: List mowers who have expressed interest in servicing a group, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id AND (mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = mower_interests.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: list_interests_for_mower
tools.description: List the calling mower's own interests
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interests WHERE mower_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: create_mower_interest
tools.description: Express the caller's (a mower's) interest in servicing a group (upsert on mower+group; the caller is the mower)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_interests (id, group_id, mower_id, message, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :__user_id, :message, :__now, :__now FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'mower' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND g.status = 'forming') ON CONFLICT (mower_id, group_id) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: delete_mower_interest
tools.description: Delete a mower interest and its votes atomically — either the mower who owns it, or a group admin / platform admin of the target group
statements: DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mower_interests mi WHERE mi.id = :id AND (mi.mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = mi.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))))

DELETE FROM mower_interests WHERE id = :id AND (mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = mower_interests.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))))

tools.name: cast_vote
tools.description: Cast or change the caller's vote on a mower interest (voter is the verified caller; upsert on interest+voter)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_interest_votes (interest_id, voter_id, vote, created_at) SELECT :interest_id, :__user_id, :vote, :__now FROM mower_interests mi JOIN street_groups g ON g.id = mi.group_id JOIN users u ON u.id = :__user_id WHERE mi.id = :interest_id AND u.role = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) ON CONFLICT(interest_id, voter_id) DO UPDATE SET vote = excluded.vote, created_at = excluded.created_at

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List all votes on a mower interest, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :interest_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mower_interests mi JOIN street_groups g ON g.id = mi.group_id WHERE mi.id = :interest_id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id)))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: vote_tally
tools.description: Up/down vote counts for a mower interest
tools.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :interest_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mower_interests mi JOIN street_groups g ON g.id = mi.group_id WHERE mi.id = :interest_id AND (mi.mower_id = :__user_id OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.member_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) c WHERE c.value = :__user_id)))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))
